template.name: Garden Index
template.reusable_market: Personal PR base for individuals, operators, makers, small studios, and small businesses.

positioning.first_impression: A personal root with a clear path into deeper public notes.
positioning.curiosity_strategy: Feature the docs route as the deeper room while keeping the root direct.

audience_modes.intent: Check work, resume, docs, and GitHub quickly.
Get a curated glimpse of the person and choose a social/contact path.
Find the right way to contact or schedule.

reference_set.role: Digital garden and visual note reference
avoid: making the page feel like a generic template
making the page feel like a generic template

copy_rules: Use plain nouns and direct action labels.
Do not add pitch copy to compensate for weak structure.
Route labels and URLs are content-contract invariants.

experience_contract.first_screen: A personal root with a clear path into deeper public notes.
experience_contract.navigation_model: Shared route content rendered as template-owned navigation objects.
experience_contract.progressive_disclosure: The root shows enough to invite action and leaves deeper explanation to linked surfaces.
interaction_requirements: All links are tappable on mobile.
No route depends on hover-only meaning.

layout: two-part hero with docs feature card
three-column route grid on desktop and single-column mobile
texture: Use surface, spacing, and line quality instead of decorative effects.

motion_contract.policy: Motion may guide attention, never carry meaning.
allowed: subtle hover background on route rows

implementation_scope.build_status: Implemented as a governed template preview.
implementation_scope.activation_rule: Only activate after mobile and desktop screenshot comparison beats the current active template for its intended question.

selection_criteria: Feels personal and credible without overexplaining.
